my_lead: 2j (co-named with 2k: 'Analogues 2j and 2k had the best antipromastigote activities')

reactions.issue: Monosubstituted ethylene glycol (3 eq) + PBr3 (1 eq), CHCl3, 0 C then reflux 60 C 12 h -> bromide 1j (crude, 70-90% for series). PBr3 supplies the Br so listing is right. The paper calls this 'Hell-Volhard-Zelinsky' but it is OH -> Br. The glycol for 1j is never printed; 2-(4-bromophenoxy)ethanol is deduced from the name of 2j (3-[2-(4-bromophenoxy)ethyl]); the O-arylated analogues 2i-l confirm aryloxy glycols.
Nitrofurantoin (Et3N, DMF) + 1j (2 eq), rt 48 h -> 2j, 10%. Alkylation at the hydantoin N3-H (the 11.1 ppm NH signal disappears), consistent with SMILES; E configuration kept.

leaf_issues: 2-(4-bromophenoxy)ethanol: not named anywhere in the main text; support is only 'All chemicals and reagents were purchased from various suppliers' (4.1.1). No SI was available, so the glycol identity rests on the product name.
notes: 2 steps. Lead 2j vs 2k is a genuine tie (2j best vs L. major, 0.19 uM; 2k best vs L. donovani, 0.73 vs 0.78 uM). The bromide 1j is not characterised in the main text.
